description: This file contains the implementation of the CalDAVProvider class, which extends AbstractCalendarProvider. It provides functionality to connect to CalDAV servers, perform CRUD operations on calendar events, and handle authentication via HTTP Basic Auth. The class includes methods for testing connection, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting events, and parsing iCalendar data.

classes.name: CalDAVProvider
classes.description: Implementation of a CalDAV calendar provider supporting connection testing, event synchronization (fetch, create, update, delete) via HTTP Basic Authentication and parsing of iCalendar data.

methods.name: testCalendarConnection
methods.description: Tests the connection to the CalDAV server by performing a PROPFIND request and handling responses to determine connection status.

methods.name: getAuthHeaders
methods.description: Prepares the HTTP Basic Auth headers using username and password from the connection object.

methods.name: getCalendarUrl
methods.description: Retrieves the calendar URL from the connection configuration.

methods.name: makeCalDAVRequest
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request to the CalDAV server with specified method, URL, headers, and optional body, returning the response code and body.

methods.name: buildPropfindXml
methods.description: Constructs the XML payload for the PROPFIND request to discover calendar properties.

methods.name: getEvents
methods.description: Retrieves calendar events from the CalDAV server based on a query, parsing the response XML into CalendarAccountEvent objects.

methods.name: formatDateTimeAsUTC
methods.description: Converts a DateTime object to UTC and formats it for iCalendar.

methods.name: buildCalendarQueryXml
methods.description: Constructs the XML payload for calendar-query REPORT requests, including optional time range filters.

methods.name: parseCalendarQueryResponse
methods.description: Parses the XML response from a calendar-query REPORT to extract events as CalendarAccountEvent objects.

methods.name: parseICalendarData
methods.description: Parses an iCalendar VEVENT data string into a CalendarAccountEvent object, interpreting DTSTART, DTEND, SUMMARY, and other custom fields.

methods.name: parseICalDateTime
methods.description: Parses an iCalendar date-time string into a PHP DateTime object, handling different formats including UTC and timezone-specific.

methods.name: calculateEndDateFromDuration
methods.description: Calculates the event end DateTime based on start date and an ISO 8601 duration string.

methods.name: unescapeICalValue
methods.description: Unescapes special characters in iCalendar data strings.

methods.name: getEvent
methods.description: Retrieves a single calendar event by its target ID from the server and parses it into a CalendarAccountEvent.

methods.name: doCreateEvent
methods.description: Creates a new calendar event by converting a CalendarAccountEvent into iCalendar format and sending a PUT request.

methods.name: convertToICalendar
methods.description: Serializes a CalendarAccountEvent object into an iCalendar string for storage.

methods.name: escapeICalValue
methods.description: Escapes special characters for safe inclusion in iCalendar data.

methods.name: doUpdateEvent
methods.description: Updates an existing event on the server with new data from a CalendarAccountEvent.

methods.name: doDeleteEvent
methods.description: Deletes an event on the server identified by its target ID.
